name: The Clean
source:
On a floating island (Kiri), a utopia for evil geniuses, upon coming of age this one apprentice has been sentenced to die, unless He can make a girl fall in love with him with in 7 days. He must make her fall in love with him then bring her back to be killed and sacrificed for his evil genius inauguration ceremony.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=3737]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
在名为“雾”的浮岛上，邪恶天才们建起了一座乌托邦。一名学徒成年时遭到死刑判决，除非他能在7天之内让一个女孩爱上自己。他必须先赢得她的爱，再把她带回岛上杀死，作为自己晋升邪恶天才仪式的祭品。

[引自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=3737]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
